title: Testing and code quality: agent skills for TYPO3
header: Testing and code quality in 86 seconds
description: A bug report becomes a failing test, journeys run in a real browser, and extension code is checked and cleaned without changing what it does. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 86 seconds: Testing and code quality, 4 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-testing, typo3-playwright, typo3-conformance, typo3-simplify). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: A bug that comes back should have been a test the first time.
Testing and code quality: four skills for TYPO3 v14.
Unit, functional and end-to-end tests, and a reported bug reproduced as a failing test first.
A test written after the fix proves only that the code does what it does.
Builds and repairs Playwright tests for visitor and editor journeys, with isolated fixtures.
A unit test cannot click a filter or save a link dialog.
Checks an extension against TYPO3 standards: versions, coding standards, deprecations and TER readiness.
A version bump that leaves half the files behind is easy to miss.
Cleans up extension code for clarity and v14 patterns without changing what it does.
It replaces custom code with what TYPO3 already provides, and checks that the behaviour stays the same.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
